strongest_angle: Trace the sudden September 2026 collapse of the iconic 90-foot Hōlei Sea Arch in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park after standing for approximately 550 years.

key_facts.fact: The 90-foot-tall Hōlei Sea Arch located in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park collapsed into the Pacific Ocean in late September 2026.
The lava rock structure formed about 550 years ago and was last seen intact on September 23, 2026, before being discovered gone by September 27, 2026.
Park officials believe the feature along the Big Island southern coastline collapsed in late September as a hurricane brushed past the area.
